title: Studio Dark tokens
summary: The base design-token sheet: 150 CSS custom properties (surfaces, text, accent, handle colours, spacing, radii, type scale, motion, one z-index scale). Token names match NodeMode exactly. Load it first; themes overwrite the theme-owned values at runtime.
description: The first stylesheet every form app loads. Dark is the default; light is a `body.theme-light` override layer (see `css.panels-dialogs` and `theme.profiles-14`). Token NAMES equal the names NodeMode's own stylesheets read, so sheets copied from NodeMode work unchanged. VALUES are the Studio Dark profile; `themes.ts` and the pre-paint boot overwrite the theme-owned ones. B06 counts 162 properties; the file defines 150 distinct names at formvis 1.98.4. Rules the file encodes: colour comes from a token never a literal; every z-index is a `var(--z-*)` from the scale; dark by default.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

invariants.text: Every colour, space and radius comes from a token in the studio-dark token set (var(--bg-*), var(--text-*), var(--border-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*)); no literal colour values in component code.
Stacking above local ordering uses var(--z-*) from the one z scale; a raw numeric z-index is not allowed.
Token names equal the names NodeMode reads (its _variables.css); never rename a token, add new names instead.
The only literal colours allowed are semantic ones (credits green, danger red, handle colours) and they live in this file as named tokens so they stay greppable.

examples.title: A component rule reading only tokens
examples.whenToUse: When writing a new modal or panel stylesheet: copy the pattern of z-index from var(--z-*) and colours from var(--bg-*) tokens.
